test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 16 March 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A disease persisting for a long time or recurring again and again
solution:
The correct answer is "**Chronic**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **Certified: **officially recognized as possessing certain qualifications or meeting certain standards.
 
• **Confirmed: **(of a person) firmly established in a particular habit, belief, or way of life and unlikely to change their ways.
 
• **Chronological: **(of a record of events) following the order in which they occurred.
 
• **Chronic: **(of an illness) persisting for a long time or constantly recurring.
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**chronic**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
 
 
• **Example**: T*he sick child was diagnosed with **chronic **__bronchitis by the doctor*.
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
• **Certified: ** आधिकारिक तौर पर कुछ योग्यता रखने या कुछ मानकों को पूरा करने के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त है।
 
• **Confirmed: ** (किसी व्यक्ति का) किसी विशेष आदत, विश्वास या जीवन शैली में दृढ़ता से स्थापित और उनके तरीके बदलने की संभावना नहीं है।
 
• **Chronological: ** (घटनाओं के रिकॉर्ड का) जिस क्रम में वे घटित हुए थे।
 
• **Chronic: ** (किसी बीमारी का) लंबे समय तक बना रहना या लगातार आवर्ती होना।
 
• As per the meaning of the given words, "**chronic**" is the one-word substitute for the given group of words.
